msg: The consistency of the rewards from the Gnomes change over time. 9 mushrooms are the highest that can be obtained from the forest at once. The choices are always either a Green or Red Gnome pair, or a Brown and Purple Gnome pair. The consistency of the Red and Purple Gnomes are the same throughout. That means if the Red Gnome is not giving good rewards at the moment, the Purple one is not giving good rewards as well. Likewise, the Green Gnome and Brown Gnome share the same consistency. The best strategy for me was to wait until a Gnome gave around 3 or 2 mushrooms and then switch to the other color pair. If Red is giving 5, 6, or 7 consistently, then continue picking Red and Purple Gnomes until it goes down. If you're good, you can kind of predict when the next Gnome pair will start giving good rewards. Green and Brown Gnomes might be giving 7 or 8 consistently, then it slowly goes down to 4 or 5. At that point, you might be able to just switch to Red/Purple Gnomes and never have to find a forest with 2 or 0 mushrooms.
